‘Nights at a Round Table’ features tales from the Character Actors Dining Society — including PEOPLE’s 2026 Sexiest Man Alive
Alberto Rodriguez/Deadline via Getty; Crown
The Character Actors Dining Society (CADS) is a group of 17 actors who gather for meals and enjoy each other’s company away from the cameras
In new book Nights at a Round Table , the group — which includes Noah Wyle, Bryan Cranston and more — shares their wisdom with readers
Proceeds from the Feb. 23, 2027 release will support several charities
In 2018, a group of actors started sharing stories over a meal in Hollywood. But what began as a series of small, casual dinners soon became a ritual, which built a sense of camaraderie away from the cameras. This group became known as the Character Actors Dining Society, or CADS, and is now made up of 17 actors from across the industry: Jason Alexander , Danny Burstein , LeVar Burton , Bryan Cranston , Laurence Fishburne , Spencer Garrett, Richard Kind , Eric McCormack , Paul McCrane , Michael McKean , Alfred Molina , Rob Morrow, Michael Nouri, Kevin Pollak, Steven Weber, Titus Welliver and Noah Wyle . Now, the members of CADS are sharing their wisdom — and dinner conversation topics — for the first time in a new book.
PEOPLE can exclusively reveal the cover of Nights at a Round Table: True Stories of Fame, Family, Failure, Frivolity, and Friendship , out next spring from Crown, an imprint of Penguin Random House.
Described as a “group portrait of some of the most beloved actors of a generation,” Nights at a Round Table captures the friendship and humor that makes up CADS, and includes never-before-published stories about the group’s careers, the entertainment industry, family and friends.

The book also traces the members’ vulnerability, as they detail their successes and failures.
John Nacion/FilmMagic; John Lamparski/Getty; Leon Bennett/Getty
“The CADS book idea grew rapidly, but slowed way down when we realized that all the money goes to charity … but then picked up again when we got glowing praise for it that we so desperately need,” Cranston quips in a quote shared with PEOPLE.
An audiobook narration, read by many of the authors, will also be released by Penguin Random House Audio. “I wish I had a dime for every laugh and smile I had or saw at a CADS gathering, but nothing would match the riches of being a part of this group of extraordinary gentlemen,” Morrow adds. Nights at a Round Table: True Stories of Fame, Family, Failure, Frivolity, and Friendship will be published on Feb. 23, 2027 and is now available for preorder, wherever books are sold.
Proceeds from the book will go toward a variety of 501(c)(3) charities.
